settings.title: Developer options
settings.help: Settings and numbers for developers: measuring what uses the battery, trying things out, finding faults.

settings.title: Language
settings.help: Language of menus and messages.

settings.title: Night mode
settings.help: White text on black.

settings.title: Pictures in night mode inverted
settings.help: Off: covers and photos as they are, not as negatives.

settings.title: Text darkness
settings.help: How full letters are drawn without grays; full helps on pale screens.

settings.title: Say what is chosen
settings.help: Says the row or button the buttons move to, for using PaperPaw without looking.

settings.title: Voice
settings.help: What reads aloud. Automatic: the system's voice, or where the device has none, a plugin's that speaks the language; or a plugin's for the languages it speaks.

settings.title: Edges for swipes: top and bottom
settings.help: How far in from the edge a swipe still counts as one in from the edge (home, quick panel, back); 0: none there. Where the system takes the outermost strip for its own swipes, it keeps it.

settings.title: Edges for swipes: left and right
settings.help: How far in from the edge a swipe still counts as one in from the edge (home, quick panel, back); 0: none there. Where the system takes the outermost strip for its own swipes, it keeps it.

settings.title: Library folder
settings.help: The folder with your books.

settings.title: Device name
settings.help: What this reader is called where others see it: Calibre, the progress server, your router and a phone setting up Wi-Fi. Takes effect the next time it connects.

settings.title: Menu text size
settings.help: Size of menus, lists and the status line.

settings.title: Contrast
settings.help: Strong draws gray hints and notes in black, easier to read on screens with few grays.

settings.title: Headers
settings.help: The top of menus and lists: the title on the page, black on white with a line below, or white on black.

settings.title: Frames of widgets
settings.help: One frame for every widget whose own is not chosen in its settings: a line, a card, a dark card or none.

settings.title: Corners
settings.help: Of highlighted rows, buttons and boxes; round and soft ones make buttons and switches pills.

settings.title: Highlight
settings.help: How the chosen row is shown: a dark bar, a frame, or a light bar (a frame on screens of black and white alone).

settings.title: Lines between rows
settings.help: Light lines, fainter lines from where the text starts, or none.

settings.title: Groups
settings.help: The sections of lists as they are or on rounded cards.

settings.title: Title size
settings.help: Size of the titles at the top of menus and lists, in percent of the text's.

settings.title: Margins of menus
settings.help: Space at the left and right of menus and lists.

settings.title: Row height
settings.help: Height of the rows of menus and lists, relative to their text.

settings.title: Lines
settings.help: How thick lines and frames are drawn.

settings.title: Logo picture
settings.help: A picture (JPEG, PNG) shown in place of PaperPaw's logo, e.g. plugins/mine/logo.png. Empty for PaperPaw's own.

settings.title: Grays
settings.help: The grays of the interface by what they are for, e.g. muted=60 line=170 (0 black, 255 white). Empty for the usual ones.

settings.title: Button layout
settings.help: What the device's buttons do.

settings.title: Full refresh
settings.help: A flashing refresh after this many page turns removes ghosting; 0 never flashes.

settings.title: Flash when screens change
settings.help: A full refresh when another screen opens leaves no trace of the last one, but takes longer: three and a half seconds on the X4.

settings.title: Pictures in grays
settings.help: A screen with pictures, such as covers or a sleep screen's picture, shows them in four grays when it opens or changes whole: finer, but a little slower to show. What changes on it after shows in black and white.

settings.title: Sleep after
settings.help: Minutes without use after which the device goes to sleep by itself; 0: never. Not while reading aloud or downloading.

settings.title: Turn the screen
settings.help: Upright or on its side, e.g. for pictures and comics. Turned while reading with “Only this book” on, it is turned for that book alone.

settings.title: Show what the buttons do
settings.help: A row at the bottom of the screen names what each button below it does. Not while reading.

settings.title: Swap the page buttons
settings.help: While reading, the page buttons turn the other way: the one that went forward goes back, and the other way round. Menus and lists keep them as they are.

settings.title: Messages show for
settings.help: How long short messages such as “Sync done” stay on the screen.

settings.title: Long press
settings.help: How long to hold a button or finger for a long press.

settings.title: Double tap
settings.help: How quickly a second tap or press must follow the first to count as a double tap, where something is bound to one.

settings.title: Tap tolerance
settings.help: How far a finger may move and still tap.

settings.title: Swipe distance
settings.help: How far a finger must move to swipe.

settings.title: Front light
settings.help: How bright the front light is; 0 switches it off.

settings.title: Front light warmth
settings.help: How warm the front light is: 0 cold, 100 warm.

settings.title: Size
settings.help: The height of every space.

settings.title: Text colour
settings.help: Softer than black on white, easier on the eyes on bright screens. Pictures take the colours too; night mode swaps them.

settings.title: Own text colour
settings.help: A colour code such as #5b4636 (red, green, blue), used when the colour above is "Own colour".

settings.title: Paper colour
settings.help: Softer than black on white, easier on the eyes on bright screens. Pictures take the colours too; night mode swaps them.

settings.title: Own paper colour
settings.help: A colour code such as #5b4636 (red, green, blue), used when the colour above is "Own colour".

settings.title: Font
settings.help: The font of the status lines while reading: as the menus', as the book's, or one of its own.

settings.title: Font
settings.help: The book's font is Literata, or the fonts a book brings on devices that draw them (not the X4 and X4 Pro). Any other font is used for all text.

settings.title: Font size
settings.help: Size of the book text.

settings.title: Line spacing
settings.help: Distance between lines, relative to the font size. Below 100 % lines come closer than the font sets them, for fonts with much room between lines.

settings.title: Font weight
settings.help: Darker, bolder text with any font; helps on light screens.

settings.title: Word spacing
settings.help: Space between words; at 100 % as the font has it.

settings.title: Margins
settings.help: Space between the text and the edges of the screen; at the top and bottom too, unless those have margins of their own.

settings.title: Margins at the top and bottom
settings.help: Space above and below the text. As the margins at the sides until it is changed.

settings.title: Justify text
settings.help: Align paragraphs on both sides.

settings.title: Hyphenate words
settings.help: Break long words at the end of lines, in the book's language.

settings.title: Publisher's formatting
settings.help: Use the book's own layout (alignment, emphasis set in styles). Off shows the text plainly; emphasis in the text and headings stay.

settings.title: Indent paragraphs
settings.help: Indent the first line of each paragraph.

settings.title: Space between paragraphs
settings.help: Leave some space between paragraphs, with or without indented first lines.

settings.title: Lines kept at the top
settings.help: The fewest lines of a paragraph alone at the top of a page: more go on with them.

settings.title: Lines kept at the bottom
settings.help: The fewest lines of a paragraph alone at the bottom of a page: with fewer, the paragraph begins on the next page.

settings.title: Reading app
settings.help: The app books open in; each format may have its own, and a book or a folder too (Open with).

settings.title: Footnotes
settings.help: A tapped note mark (1, [2], *) shows its note over the page, or goes to it.

settings.title: Page frame
settings.help: How the text is set on the page: in one column, or as a plugin frames it (two columns, two pages side by side).

settings.title: Only this book
settings.help: Changes to font and layout apply to this book only (marked •). Off: the book uses the general settings again.

settings.title: Background
settings.help: A colour behind the marked words; shown as a gray where there is no colour.

settings.title: Text
settings.help: The colour of the marked words themselves; as it is, or a tone of its own.

settings.title: Line under the text
settings.help: A line under the marked words: solid, dotted, dashed, wavy or double.

settings.title: Line and frame
settings.help: The colour of the line and the frame.

settings.title: Thickness
settings.help: How thick the line and the frame are.

settings.title: Time zone

settings.title: Time zone rule
settings.help: For zones not in the list: a POSIX TZ rule, e.g. CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3. Overrides the time zone.

settings.title: Dictionary folder

settings.title: Distance from the edge

settings.title: Status lines

settings.title: Status lines

settings.title: Top left

settings.title: Top centre

settings.title: Battery in percent
settings.help: The charge as a number beside the battery symbol.

settings.title: Smooth text
settings.help: Letters with soft gray edges on screens without grays; pages turn slower and use more battery.

settings.title: Reopen the last book at start
settings.help: Start with the last book instead of the home screen.

settings.title: Bookmark by tapping the corner
settings.help: A tap on the top right corner of a page sets or removes its bookmark.

settings.title: Hold a page button for the next chapter
settings.help: While reading, holding a page button goes a chapter on or back. Off, a page turns as soon as its button goes down, instead of when it is let go.

settings.title: Turn pages automatically every
settings.help: For “Turn pages automatically” in the reader’s menu.

settings.title: Speed
settings.help: How fast books are read aloud.

settings.title: Underline the sentence
settings.help: Shows which sentence is being read.

settings.title: Turn pages
settings.help: Reads on over the pages; else it stops at the end of the page.

settings.title: Stop after
settings.help: Reading aloud stops by itself after this long, e.g. at bedtime.

settings.title: Archive folder
settings.help: Where “Move to the archive” puts finished books.

settings.title: Show books as
settings.help: A list with covers and how far each book is read, or a grid of large covers.

settings.title: Order of books
settings.help: How the library sorts books: those read last first, or by title.

settings.title: Columns

settings.title: Rows
settings.help: How many cells it has down; 0: as many as make the cells about square.

settings.title: Names under the tools
settings.help: The tools on the home screen with their names, or only their icons.

settings.title: Show the focus at once
settings.help: Whether the frame showing what the buttons choose is there as soon as the home screen shows, or only after the first press.

settings.title: The status line at the top

settings.title: Pencil below the page

settings.title: Dots for the pages

settings.title: More below the page

settings.title: Line

settings.title: Power mode
settings.help: PaperPaw saves energy in every mode. Saving does what can wait at better moments; Offline keeps the radio off. Automatic chooses by the battery.

settings.title: Saving below (%)
settings.help: Automatic switches to Saving when the battery falls below this.

settings.title: Offline below (%)
settings.help: Automatic switches to Offline when the battery falls below this, so the book can be finished.

settings.title: Normal while charging

settings.title: Plugin library

settings.title: Screen lock
settings.help: Asks for a PIN, a pattern or a password when PaperPaw starts and when the device wakes up. It keeps others from casual use, not from someone who takes the files.

settings.title: Lock when waking up
settings.help: Off: the lock is asked for only when PaperPaw starts and by “Lock now”. Where every wake is a start (the X4 on battery), it is asked for then too.

settings.title: Lock touch
